title: Stop the harness depending on auto-generated lots before ITER-0005
description:
TestCtx::build_house_near (simulation/src/tests/mod.rs) picks a lot from self.g.map().lots(). That collection is populated ONLY because Lot::generate_along_road runs live from Map::connect (simulation/src/map/map.rs:719).

STORY-0013 'Stop roads from auto-spawning speculative building lots' (verdict CONFLICTS, scheduled ITER-0005) deliberately kills that. When it lands, build_house_near breaks, and with it the vehicles.rs tests at simulation/src/tests/vehicles.rs:57,67,110,120.

Do: give the harness an explicit building-placement path (WorldCommand::MapBuildSpecialBuilding is the pattern already used at souls/freight_station.rs:176-190) and migrate callers off build_house_near BEFORE ITER-0005.

TRAP: the inherited brief claimed generate_along_road was ALREADY disabled. It is not - that claim was false and reached ~20 agent dispatches. Verify against map.rs:719 before believing any restatement of it.

title: Give TestCtx a seed and a fast tick before the journey harness grows
description:
Two gaps found while reviewing the walking-skeleton harness plan.

1. NO SEED. SimulationOptions exposes only terrain_size and save_replay. JOURNEY-0001's final observable claims 'identical seed and inputs yield identical ledger figures', but there is no seed field - today that can only mean 'identical construction'. Either add a seed or reword the observable.

2. TICK COST. TestCtx::tick() does a full bincode encode + decode + per-key hashes() comparison EVERY tick. That is exactly the determinism guarantee we want, but it will dominate runtime on a multi-hundred-tick journey. Add a tick_fast() without the round-trip and keep the checked tick for boundaries.

Not blocking ITER-0000, which is short. Becomes painful as journeys lengthen.

title: Author the walking-skeleton journey and a real sentinel corpus
description:
PARTIALLY DONE 2026-08-22: JOURNEY-0001 'A mill hoards coal and the planner catches it from observable state alone' now exists (kind: journey, e2e seam, in production-resources.json so it survives re-aggregation) and is the walking-skeleton journey for ITER-0000.

REMAINING: the sentinel corpus is JOURNEY-0001 plus five SCENARIO-* promoted from e2e seam as a seed. Author real cross-domain journeys - coal train -> mill -> construction cascade; citizen daily round; plan quota -> hoarding -> detection - and add them to the sentinel set.

TRAPS:
- Sentinels re-run EVERY iteration as the regression baseline. A slow or flaky sentinel poisons every future sprint. Prefer integration seams on TestCtx over e2e where it can still falsify.
- Scenario IDs are REASSIGNED on every re-aggregation. behavior-corpus.md tracks sentinels by TITLE and asserts if one goes missing - keep that invariant.
- A journey must have kind:'journey' in an extract/*.json to get a JOURNEY-NNNN id; aggregate_scenarios.py keys off that field. Authoring it directly in behavior-scenarios.md would be clobbered on the next re-aggregation.

title: Scope the roadmap from the extracted requirements
description:
Run iterative-development:scoping-the-simplest-core against docs/superpowers/iterations/requirements/ to pick the walking-skeleton iteration and order the rest into roadmap.md.

Walking skeleton is THE DISHONEST ENTERPRISE - a plant that misreports output to the planner. SCENARIO-0090 'Player detects a hoarding enterprise from its inspection panel alone' already exists at e2e seam and is marked sentinel; it is the natural first journey.

TRAPS:
- The corpus doubled during PAR remediation (139 stories / 361 ACs / 151 scenarios). The roadmap WILL read long. Do not trim by deleting requirements - the lever is the deferred:true flag, same mechanism already used for per-currency loans in economy-trade.json. See sov-scope-cut.
- Ignore any src/sim/ or src/game/ path referenced in spec/ - that Bevy track is deleted. This is an Egregoria fork.
- spec/ describes INTENT, not code. Check docs/egregoria-substrate-audit.md for what actually exists.
- Read docs/superpowers/iterations/RESUME.md first.

title: Author scenarios for the 31 stories with zero coverage
description:
Adversarial scope review (2 opus reviewers + 1 verifier, 2026-08-22) found scheduled stories whose every AC lacks a scenario: tag.

WARNING: story IDs are REASSIGNED on every re-aggregation. The list below is valid as of commit-time on 2026-08-22. Regenerate it rather than trusting it:
  grep '^\*\*Stories without planned evidence:\*\*' docs/superpowers/iterations/roadmap.md

Currently uncovered: STORY-0002 STORY-0005 STORY-0012 STORY-0016 STORY-0017 STORY-0019 STORY-0020 STORY-0022 STORY-0026 STORY-0027 STORY-0032 STORY-0033 STORY-0034 STORY-0036 STORY-0037 STORY-0038 STORY-0039 STORY-0055 STORY-0080 STORY-0088 STORY-0096 STORY-0097 STORY-0109 STORY-0111 STORY-0112 STORY-0116 STORY-0118 STORY-0119 STORY-0120 STORY-0128 STORY-0129 STORY-0131 STORY-0134 STORY-0137 STORY-0142 STORY-0143 STORY-0145 STORY-0147 STORY-0148

Worst iteration is ITER-0013 (8 of 9 uncovered) - the depth stories: vehicle manufacture, locomotive/wagon consists, scrapyard recovery, passengers-as-cargo, multi-modal stations, rail siding, renewable modulation, calendar depletion. ITER-0003 (6 of 11) is the same shape in a load-bearing position - the logistics circulatory system every later iteration assumes works.

DECISION MADE: deferred deliberately. running-an-iteration decomposes each iteration into code AND evidence tasks, so scenarios get authored when the iteration runs. Pre-authoring all of them now risks writing them against stubs.

TRAP: that deferral is only safe if each iteration's evidence task actually fires. If an iteration closes without authoring scenarios for its zero-coverage stories, the debt becomes permanent and the audit closes green on nothing. Check this ticket at EVERY iteration boundary.
The roadmap prints the per-iteration uncovered list under each iteration - it is generated, not hand-maintained.

title: Decide the 1.0 scope cut against the roadmap
description:
GATE. The extracted corpus is 139 stories / 361 ACs across 35 epics - larger than a plausible 1.0. Bring the user a CONCRETE proposed cut at roadmap review; do not trim silently and do not delete requirements.

Mechanism: set deferred:true on the story (in docs/superpowers/iterations/extract/*.json) and re-run the aggregation scripts. Precedent: 'Offer per-currency loans with interest and borrowing caps' in economy-trade.json.

TRAPS:
- User has twice chosen completeness over leanness in this project (full 16-agent PAR over an 8-agent version; fix-everything over defer-thin-ACs). Lead with a recommendation but expect the fuller option to win. Do not pre-trim to save their time.
- charter-1.0.md binds on identity/posture/never/post-1.0 lists. Its rung sequencing was re-cut post-fork and does NOT bind. When charter and spec/ conflict on SCOPE, charter wins; on MECHANISM inside an in-scope rung, spec wins.
